description: Takes artwork off a line: one design's file (design, and side for one face only), or on a one-design job the front, the back, or (no side) every file. The file itself is deleted only if no other line, quote or order uses it. Refused when the line's artwork can no longer change. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

target.description: The line, and the design (and side, for one face only) to remove. On a one-design job, no side removes every file.

design.description: Which design (1 to N) on a job with several designs. Omit on a one-design job.

kind.description: cart_line (line_id from get_cart), quote_line (line_id from get_quote) or order_item (item_id from get_order).

side.description: front (default) or back, on a double-sided job.

name: remove_artwork

complete.description: Designs with every face they need.

designs.description: Which file and page is each design's front and back, as the site resolves them.

title: Remove artwork from a line
